surprises.head: Stuart Skinner stole one
surprises.body: Skinner allowed 2 goals on 36 shots, worth 4.5 expected goals: 2.5 fewer than expected. That is more than Winnipeg’s winning margin. Starting goalies have a night this good about once every 25 starts.

story.head: Skinner robs the Red Wings in Detroit
paras: Tyrel Bauer and Keegan Kolesar fought midway through the first. Cole Perfetti and Kyle Connor scored power-play goals a minute and a half apart later in the period to put the Jets up 2-0. Connor scored again on the power play early in the second to make it 3-0, and that one stood up as the winner. Viktor Arvidsson scored his first goal for Detroit on the power play late in the period to get the Red Wings on the board. Emmitt Finnie pulled the Wings within one early in the third. There were two three-point nights: Perfetti with a goal and two assists, and Connor with two goals and an assist.

The Red Wings had the better of the play. Replay the chances a hundred times and the Red Wings win about seven in ten. Stuart Skinner made the difference in net, stopping 34 of 36. John Gibson stopped 24 of 27 for the Red Wings.
The Jets went 3-for-4 on the power play. The Jets improved to 1-0-1, and the Red Wings dropped to 0-2-0.
